5m:
time_bucket(INTERVAL '300 seconds', time) AS time_bucket,
            symbol,
            FIRST(LEAST(GREATEST(open, LEAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 1 = 0 THEN open END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 2 = 0 THEN high END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 4 = 0 THEN low END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 8 = 0 THEN close END)), GREATEST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 1 = 0 THEN open END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 2 = 0 THEN high END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 4 = 0 THEN low END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 8 = 0 THEN close END)), time) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(off_tape, 0) <> 15) AS open,
            MAX(LEAST(GREATEST(high, LEAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 1 = 0 THEN open END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 2 = 0 THEN high END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 4 = 0 THEN low END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 8 = 0 THEN close END)), GREATEST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 1 = 0 THEN open END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 2 = 0 THEN high END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 4 = 0 THEN low END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 8 = 0 THEN close END))) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(off_tape, 0) <> 15) AS high,
            MIN(LEAST(GREATEST(low, LEAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 1 = 0 THEN open END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 2 = 0 THEN high END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 4 = 0 THEN low END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 8 = 0 THEN close END)), GREATEST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 1 = 0 THEN open END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 2 = 0 THEN high END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 4 = 0 THEN low END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 8 = 0 THEN close END))) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(off_tape, 0) <> 15) AS low,
            LAST(LEAST(GREATEST(close, LEAST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 1 = 0 THEN open END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 2 = 0 THEN high END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 4 = 0 THEN low END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 8 = 0 THEN close END)), GREATEST(CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 1 = 0 THEN open END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 2 = 0 THEN high END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 4 = 0 THEN low END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(off_tape, 0) & 8 = 0 THEN close END)), time) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(off_tape, 0) <> 15) AS close,
